purpose: Sparse deterministic family, marriage, household, parentage, guardianship and succession lifecycle. Family status is institutional/life-course state, not a substitute for relationship feelings or reputation.

authority_boundaries.family_status: state/family/ owns proposals, unions, households, direct recognized kinship, parentage/guardianship and succession state.
authority_boundaries.relationships: Trust, affection, resentment, intimacy posture and personal history remain in the relationship authority.
authority_boundaries.reputation: Audience beliefs about a marriage/House/lineage remain under state/reputation/ after valid evidence delivery.
authority_boundaries.property_and_office: Property, treasury, title, office and command remain in their existing domain owners; family state references but never duplicates them.
authority_boundaries.health: Pregnancy, childbirth injury, illness and recovery, when applicable, use the existing health/body authority rather than family files.
authority_boundaries.knowledge: Private proposals, parentage, marriage terms and household facts are not automatically public knowledge.

lifecycle.courtship: Optional sparse state only after actual mutual/declared in-world courtship becomes persistent. Attraction or speculation alone does not create a courtship record.
lifecycle.proposal: A real in-world offer may persist as pending before acceptance. The target remains free to accept, decline, negotiate, delay or ignore where law/custom permits.
lifecycle.betrothal: A recognized engagement/contract distinct from marriage. It can create obligations and political expectations without creating spouse status.
lifecycle.marriage: Creates/updates an authoritative union record after actual consent/authority/custom requirements are resolved. Relationship feelings remain separate.
lifecycle.household: Created only when residence, dependents, shared obligations/property or domestic administration need persistent state. Marriage alone need not imply co-residence.
lifecycle.parentage: Birth/adoption/recognized parentage creates one child person and a parentage record. Never create a duplicate body because a family event occurred.
lifecycle.guardianship: Ward/guardian status is explicit, time-bounded or open-ended, and does not rewrite biological/adoptive parentage.
lifecycle.separation_and_dissolution: Separation, divorce, annulment and dissolution preserve history, property claims, dependents and reputation consequences instead of deleting the prior union.
lifecycle.widowhood: Death changes union status and triggers household/dependent/property/succession settlement through existing authorities.
lifecycle.remarriage: Creates a new union while prior unions remain historical state.
lifecycle.kinship: Direct sibling/grandparent/in-law/other recognized kinship may be stored when the relationship is known but reconstructing unknown parentage would require invention. Parent-child truth still belongs to parentage records.

player_agency.rule: A player-facing proposal may exist because an NPC acted, but no player commitment exists until the player character actually communicates/acts in-world and persistence succeeds.

inputs: registered deterministic randomness when a true tie/uncertainty requires it
forbidden: automatic marriage merely because two characters are eligible
marriage as a reward for narrative convenience
forced survival/death/children to preserve a dynasty
autonomous_npcs.batch_rule: Cold populations may be batch-settled only when chronologically and statistically equivalent; named/material relationships or threshold crossings wake exact state.

reproduction_and_birth.representation: abstract life-course only; never simulate or narrate sexual activity as a mechanical step
reproduction_and_birth.eligibility: Use setting law/custom, adult/life-stage policy, health, existing union/relationship status where relevant, player agency and actual elapsed time.
birth_transaction: resolve pregnancy/parenthood state abstractly when supported
resolve maternal/child health through health mechanics
create exactly one child person on live birth
create reputation/knowledge consequences only through valid information routes

succession_and_inheritance.rule: Marriage or parentage may change candidate eligibility/priority only through the applicable House/clan/state/law/custom rule. Never infer title, property or command transfer from kinship alone.
death_settlement_order: persist disputes/claims rather than forcing consensus
propagate known consequences through reputation/information systems

determinism.tie_break: stable IDs after all causal criteria; registered randomness only where the domain explicitly requires uncertainty and the draw is persisted
determinism.event_receipt: Every family transition records source refs and exact time. Unknown historical dates stay unknown rather than being fabricated.
determinism.no_duplicate_global_clock: Use existing life-course/institution/house/process clocks; family state does not create a second world scheduler.

knowledge_reputation.reputation_rule: Marriage/family events may create reputation evidence, prestige, notoriety or political attention only for audiences that learn of the event through valid channels.

setting_overlay.house_and_dynasty: House alliances, court politics, estates, titles, dowry/bridewealth/settlement terms where applicable, wards and inheritance may be material but must use explicit terms and existing law/property owners.
setting_overlay.political_marriage: Political advantage may motivate an offer, family negotiation or pressure. It never substitutes for Tang Wei's voluntary choice.
setting_overlay.heirs: Heir status must be stored in a succession owner with a rule basis; birth order, designation, adoption, legitimacy/status, office/law and disputes are inputs rather than assumptions.
setting_overlay.wards: Political wards/fosterage/guardianship are explicit dependent records and may carry diplomatic/security consequences.

autonomous_courtship.rule: autonomous NPC courtship uses only pre-existing exact relationship evidence and physical proximity; it never chooses or accepts for the player
